YOUR TEAM’S QUICK START

How to use this app

CargoDesk brings three export-document tools into one workspace. Choose the tool for your task; you do not need to complete them in a fixed order.

Start here

  1. Choose a document tool. Use the sidebar on a computer. On a phone, tap the ☰ menu in the top-left corner.
  2. Enter your shipment details. Replace any example values with your own shipment information. Check units, identifiers, and dates carefully.
  3. Review the result. Confirm the entered information and your team’s required checks before using the document.
  4. Save or print. Use the print button inside the document tool. Select Save as PDF where your device offers it, or choose an available printer.

Which tool should I choose?

ADR exemption auditor · Road dangerous goods

Enter consignor, consignee, vehicle, and date. Add a line for each dangerous good and enter its UN number, description, class, packing group, transport category, and quantity. Review the calculated points and displayed requirements against your applicable procedures.

CMR waybill issuer · Road consignment note

Select the copy type. Fill in sender, consignee, carrier, collection and delivery locations, goods, and any customs or seal references. Complete the relevant signature areas and review the waybill before printing.

Save Draft / Load Draft: these store and restore form fields in the same browser on this device. Drawn signatures are not included. A saved draft does not appear on a colleague’s phone.

DGR acceptance hub · Air dangerous goods

Enter the AWB number, origin, destination, and aircraft limitation. Review each documentation, package, and labelling checkpoint and choose Pass, Fail, or N/A as appropriate. Complete the inspector details and review the result and any discrepancy notice.

Review every checkpoint: the supplied tool starts with Pass selected. Its initial acceptance display is not evidence that an inspection has taken place.

Using CargoDesk on a phone

Tap ☰ to switch sections. Some document tables scroll sideways; turning your phone sideways can help when completing the full CMR form. Your device’s print and PDF options may differ.

Keep your work

Switching between tools keeps the current entries while this page stays open. Closing or refreshing can lose unsaved work. Save the CMR draft where useful and export completed documents before leaving. There is no automatic shared record or team synchronization.

Working offline

The downloaded folder works without internet. For a future shared web link, open the app once while connected and allow its files to finish loading before relying on offline access. Browser storage may be cleared by your device; check access before starting an offline shift.

Share with a colleague

Open menakod.github.io/CargoDeskApp/ on your computer or phone. Share that public link through your approved team channel. On a phone, use your browser’s Add to Home Screen option where available for a convenient shortcut. Each teammate still works independently. Share completed PDFs through your normal document process.

Date, time & weather

Open the sidebar to see your device’s date and time. Tap the city name to change the weather location. Weather needs internet to refresh; saved readings show their update time. Weather is supplied by Open-Meteo.
